acceptance_signals: A create-only task-start baseline exists before manifest or controller edits.
The manifest retains exactly 186 sorted paths and the existing path digest while its content digest equals the freshly derived identity for the README-inclusive worktree.
The controller expected content digest matches the refreshed manifest and no other runtime behavior is changed.
The prior replay evidence remains byte-identical with SHA-256 ffc06da3060b459ff39c8602365126a860e8228dd6320c8c88f69cbc8c6b8715.
The artifact chain and full repository tests pass after the identity refresh.
Fresh preflight confirms the manifest, a compatible retained Python 3.11 backend wheel, an absent new evidence target, and zero short roots before execution.
The fixed controller is invoked exactly once with one strict JSON stdin request and a new 2026-08-28 evidence target.
The replay performs no retry, alternate invocation, network access, dependency installation, external Agent, model, Git, publication, release, or deployment action.
A PASS durably writes new evidence and gates exact cleanup; a first deviation stops without repair, retry, manual cleanup, or false success.
STATUS.md and docs/development-log/2026-08-28.md distinguish the historical replay from the new maintenance replay and state the exact observed result.
Task governance, repository governance, captured scope, manifest check, task JSON, whitespace, and git diff checks have zero failures.
All pre-existing accumulated delivery files outside the exact manifest, controller constant, new task and baseline, new evidence, status, and dated log changes remain byte-identical.

decision.rationale: The accountable human reviewed structured proposal prp-787d1c97b3464fcd82a43e8860e1496e and admitted that exact task through an explicit admission control.

requirement.summary: Implement the separately selected artifact-identity refresh required by the README interview-material update. Keep the exact 186 manifest paths and path digest unchanged, refresh only the derived manifest content digest and the fixed controller identity constant, validate the repaired chain, then after fresh local preflight invoke the fixed controller exactly once with a new evidence target. Accept PASS or the first bounded deviation as the one-attempt result, never retry or overwrite prior replay evidence, record the result, and return to the already admitted Git closeout task.

items: Changing the manifest identity invalidates the controller until both values are updated consistently.
A real replay may allocate a short root that must remain untouched if evidence-gated cleanup does not complete.
The sole controller attempt cannot be retried under this task.
Broad directory scope is used to classify the accumulated dirty worktree; every pre-existing file outside the exact refresh outputs must remain unchanged.
A successful local maintenance replay does not prove portability, adoption, interview benefit, or production behavior.
